title: Coding Rules & Conventions — Akash Chouhan Portfolio
aiInstruction: Read this file before writing any code. These rules must be followed exactly. Keep this file updated whenever a new convention is agreed upon.

rules: ESM everywhere — both portfolio/ ("type": "module") and backend/ use ES modules.

fileAndFolderConventions.rule: Always use this for imports within portfolio/

importAlias.rule: Always use the @/ alias. Never use relative paths like ../../components/Navbar.

componentRules: Functional components only — no class components.
Default export each component from its own file.
Props should be destructured at the top of the function.
Use useReducedMotion() from @/hooks before adding any animation.
Heavy WebGL/3D components (ProfileCard, Beams, MoltenMetal) must be lazy-loaded or wrapped in Suspense.
shadcn-style UI primitives go in components/ui/ — use Radix + CVA pattern.
stylingRules: Never hardcode color hex values in JSX — always use var(--color-*) tokens.
Custom CSS goes in src/index.css — not in <style> tags or CSS modules.
Use @layer base, @layer components in index.css as appropriate.
Dark mode is the ONLY mode — no light mode toggle needed.
Use className not style={{}} unless animating dynamic numeric values.
animationRules: Import GSAP as: import gsap from 'gsap' and import { useGSAP } from '@gsap/react'.
Always register plugins before use: gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger).
Clean up GSAP timelines and ScrollTriggers in useEffect cleanup / useGSAP scope.
Framer Motion: use motion.* components, prefer animate + initial props over manual spring config.
Skip all animations when useReducedMotion() returns true.

Horizontal Scroll: Use GSAP snap for horizontal ScrollTrigger sections to ensure the view smoothly slides and aligns to the nearest project/panel when the user finishes scrolling. Use smooth easing (e.g. power3.inOut) and a short delay.
backendRules: Validate all inputs with express-validator before processing.
Rate limiting via express-rate-limit — already configured in middleware.
Never expose stack traces or internal error details — use generic error messages.
CORS restricted to ALLOWED_ORIGINS env variable in production.
Env vars loaded via dotenv — reference backend/.env.example for required vars.
dataManagement: Static content (projects, skills, leadership) lives in src/data/ as JS arrays/objects.
No CMS or external data fetching — keep it static.
Contact form posts to POST /api/contact on the backend.
gitAndCodeQuality: Run npm run lint (oxlint) before committing frontend changes.
Keep commits atomic — one feature/fix per commit.
No console.log in production code (console.error in backend catch blocks is OK).
doNot: Do not install new packages without asking the user first.
Do not add React Router — this is a single-page scroll site, no routing.
Do not use @apply excessively in index.css — prefer inline Tailwind.
Do not use any types if TypeScript is ever added.
